about_the_game:
.☆.｡+:ﾟ+｡.ﾟ･.☆.:・°.･ﾟ　.ﾟ･.☆｡・°.･ﾟﾟ･.☆.

Pastel☆Parade is an exhilarating rhythm game with easy controls!

Play a comfortable rhythm to the cute and poppy music.

The controls are very intuitive: just press the buttons with the right timing according to the song's beat!

//////////////////////////////////////////////////////

🎵 30 groovy original songs!

Enjoy Pastel☆Parade's catchy, cute, and unique songs!

Some of them can be quite challenging! Each play session only lasts about a minute, so you can try your hand at the songs as many times as you want.

🌟 Fun gameplay! Four bright, poppy characters!

Your rhythm influences how the characters in the game move! Their animations are lots of fun whether you can keep the beat or not!

Challenge yourself to a rhythm adventure with them!

📖 A little story too...?

As you progress through the game, its story is revealed little by little.

The world is divided into four areas, each with a different atmosphere. How far can you go?

//////////////////////////////////////////////////////

Join this fun parade with its cute characters!

.☆.｡+:ﾟ+｡.ﾟ･.☆.:・°.･ﾟ　.ﾟ･.☆｡・°.･ﾟﾟ･.☆.

Credits

Director / Programming / Animation - Matsu Friends

Art - bone

Sound Design - FALL, MasaDo, Tsuyomi, MiwoTsukushi, Akane Aomo, AMANUMA Takayuki, YMAC

Streaming Permissions

Please feel free to stream this game. When streaming, please include the title of this game and this URL in your video.
